evidence_spans.raw_text: When vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) is added to the culture, ECs line the apical ventricle, resembling the periventricular plexus (PVP) [11]. By overexpressing ETS variant transcription factor 2 (ETV2) (a transcription factor that induces EC differentiation) in stem cells before hBO development (Figure 1E), a similar PVP-like structure is observed, although it is unclear whether an INVP is formed [13]. Thus, the various vascularization approaches differ in their ability to induce the formation of neural tube vascular structures in hBOs.
